How craps works, in under a minute.

On the come out, 7 or 11 wins for the pass line and 2, 3 or 12 loses. Anything else is the point, and it has to come again before a 7. The pass line wins about 49.3% of the time at even money, a 1.41% house edge, and the loud bets in the middle are far worse.
